title: White Sox win battle of bullpen games vs. Astros, stand 1 win away from ALDS - Yahoo Sports
description: It was a tale of two bullpen games in Tuesday's wild-card opener between the Astros and White Sox. One went much better than the other.

title: Padres pummel Cubs behind Tatis' leadoff blast, King's gem in Game 1 - ESPN
description: The Padres made an emphatic statement in their wild-card opener against the Cubs, getting a leadoff homer from Fernando Tatis Jr. and a brilliant effort on the mound from Michael King in an 8-0 win in Game 1.

title: North Korea denies planting mines that injured 3 South Korean soldiers, accuses Seoul of conspiracy - AP News
description: The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has rejected South Korean findings that North Korea planted the land mines that injured three South Korean soldiers last week. She threatened to retaliate if the South fires at North Korean troops conduct…

title: Venezuelan national shot by ICE officer in Austin charged with assaulting federal officer - Fox News
description: The Justice Department charged Wilber Rafael Garces-Perez with assaulting a federal officer after an Austin vehicle pursuit ended in an ICE shooting.

title: Fiona Lowe, Daughter of Chad Lowe and Kim Painter, Dies at 13 - Variety
description: Fiona Hepler Lowe, the daughter of actor Chad Lowe and Kim Painter, died on Tuesday. She was 13.
